_comment: Ask eval over the 40-file FreshCart fixture. 'answerable' questions name the file the answer lives in; 'unanswerable' ones ask about things the shop does not have - the right answer is 'not in this project'.

answerable.q: What is the most of one product someone can add to the cart?
How is the final order total worked out at checkout?
How are prices for things sold by weight shown?
How is the delivery arrival time estimated?
How many loyalty points does a customer earn per pound, and what are they worth?
What happens when a gift card only covers part of the order?
Which messages can a customer opt out of, and which are always sent?
After how many letters do search suggestions appear?
How long before an idle shopper is warned and then signed out?
Can two promo codes be used on the same order?
How much does an order need to cost for free delivery?
What happens if the browser blocks localStorage?

unanswerable: How does the app take payments through PayPal?
Where are product reviews and star ratings stored?
How is the admin dashboard for managing stock levels set up?
Which SQL database stores the orders?
How does the customer support chatbot decide what to say?
How are returns and refunds handled?
